description: Source code for the GyroSensor class implementation in an Android hardware sensor module, handling gyroscope sensor data reading, enabling/disabling, and event processing.

classes.name: GyroSensor
classes.description: Class implementing gyroscope sensor functionality, including initialization, enabling/disabling, setting delay, and reading sensor events.

methods.name: GyroSensor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gyroscope sensor, setting up input paths and initial state.

methods.name: ~GyroSensor
methods.description: Destructor disabling the sensor if enabled.

methods.name: setInitialState
methods.description: Reads initial gyroscope values from the device and sets the pending event data.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the gyroscope sensor based on input parameter.

methods.name: hasPendingEvents
methods.description: Returns whether there are pending sensor events.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay (sampling rate) for sensor events.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Reads available gyroscope sensor events into provided data buffer.
